text:
Marta: Heads-up: marketing needs the final changelog entry, docs URL, and the benchmark blurb for next week's announcement. Target publish is 10:00 PT Tuesday. Can eng confirm timelines?
Priya: I can get the docs live at 09:00 PT if the changelog is merged by 08:30.
Leo: Working on the changelog now. I will split the breaking notes into a short line + migration link. PR incoming in ~30m.
Nora: For rollout, infra prefers a single canary at 11:00 PT (15% traffic) then full at 13:00 PT. We don't have a warm-offer window earlier that day.
Marta: Marketing wants the public post at 10:00, social + email at 10:10. If docs are 09:00 and post 10:00 that's okay. Can we confirm canary won't block the post?
Leo: Canary doesn't need to block the post. We'll set a fallback model route in case the canary triggers regressions.
Priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 512 - added changelog and migration guide link. Preview: https://docs.preview.redwood.ai/pr-512
release-bot: Docs PR #512 deployed to preview (build #1456). Checks green.
Marta: Benchmark messaging  short blurb suggestion: "~30-50% lower median latency for quantized models at 1k QPS, typical cost savings ~15%"  Thoughts?
Leo: Prefer being conservative. Change to: "observed up to ~50% median latency reduction under our synthetic 1k QPS harness; typical cost savings ~15% (see test notes)"
Nora: Add a parenthetical linking to the test harness description in the docs. Ops will need the exact CSV for the benchmark figure.
Marta: Priya, can you push the SVG + alt text to assets by EOD Monday? We need CDN path for the post.
Priya: Yes. Will upload to s3://marketing-assets/launchs/512/benchmark.svg and provide CDN URL when done.
Marta: Lead routing question: do we need a special landing page? Sales prefers a UTM + existing demo request form.
Leo: Use UTM campaign=launch_q4_512 and source=twitter. Webhook: https://hooks.internal.redwood.ai/marketing-leads-512 (service auth)
Nora: Confirmed webhook path. Will add a short ops note on auth for the webhook consumer.
Marta: Quick timeline I put in the calendar: 
```
08:30 PT - changelog merged
09:00 PT - docs live (preview -> prod)
10:00 PT - marketing public post + benchmark image
10:10 PT - social + email blast
10:15 PT - lead UTMs + webhook live
11:00 PT - canary 15% (monitor 45m)
13:00 PT - full rollout if green
```
Marta: @Leo @Nora can you confirm you can meet the 08:30 merge and 11:00 canary?
Leo: I'll merge by 08:20 PT.
Nora: Can confirm the 11:00 canary slot. Will watch metrics.
metrics-bot: Canary monitor configured: latency_p50, error_rate. Alert thresholds: p50 > baseline*1.25 or error_rate > 0.5%. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.ai/d/launch-512
Marta: Anything else blocking copy or the post?
Priya: I need the short feature bullets for the announcement and one-sentence customer benefit.
Leo: Add bullets: "1) Faster quantized inference with improved cost efficiency; 2) Configurable batching and KV cache improvements; 3) Stable rollout tooling and clear migration path." Single-sentence benefit: "Ship LLM features faster with lower latency and predictable cost."
Marta: Perfect. I'll assemble copy and share embargo calendar. Thanks all :sparkles:
